versions.changelog:
Initial release of "paper-to-table" skill for structured extraction from academic papers to review tables.

- Extracts structured data from PDF, DOCX, or TXT academic papers into XLSX or CSV literature review tables.
- Supports batch folder processing, dynamic table header mapping, duplicate detection, and preservation of original format.
- Handles both English and Chinese papers across Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience, Computer Science, and Brain Science domains.
- Ensures extraction fidelity (no missing or hallucinated info), confidence scoring, and proper handling of implied/absent data.
- Logs processing, validates outputs, supports interruption recovery, and provides batch processing reports.
